credit_lending_product.label: Credit / lending product
credit_lending_product.value: Purchased defaulted consumer receivables (non-performing loans) from banks, credit unions, consumer finance companies and retailers; also debt servicing

origination_channel.label: Origination channel
origination_channel.value: Does not originate loans; buys defaulted portfolios from financial institutions, credit unions, utilities and retailers

funding_balance_sheet_model.label: Funding / balance-sheet model
funding_balance_sheet_model.value: Capital raised and deployed to buy receivable portfolios held on balance sheet; no deposits

notes: Debt buyer rather than lender; funding and yield details are not in the evidence.
